evidence.quote:
An evaluation of the internal
consistency of the scale and its three subscales

all completed surveys accompanied with signed
informed permission forms.

The nature of the research and the little
risk involved led to oral consent instead than written permission.

A total of 278 students are needed to be surveyed to achieve a 95% confidence interval, a 5% significance level, and
80% power.
Simple randomization implemented at the course level
